summary: This document sets out BlueSky Innovations' policy on expenses and reimbursement for approved remote workers. It covers eligibility, pre-approval, documentation, exclusions and limits, reimbursement timing, company-provided equipment, and how the policy may be amended. Expenses must be reasonable, necessary, pre-approved, and reported with receipts within 30 days.
one_line: BlueSky Innovations' policy explaining which remote work expenses full-time employees can claim, how to get approval, document them, and get reimbursed.
key_facts: Full-time employees approved for remote work at BlueSky Innovations are eligible for reimbursement of work-related expenses.
Covered expenses must be reasonable, necessary, and directly related to remote work duties.
Eligible expenses typically include home internet costs, required software subscriptions, office supplies, and necessary work-related equipment.
All potential expenses must be pre-approved by the employee's direct supervisor or the finance department.
Employees request pre-approval through a form on the employee portal, submitted with any accompanying quotes or estimates.
Expense reports must be submitted no later than 30 days following the purchase.
Each expense report must include a complete Expense Reimbursement Form, original receipts or invoices, and a brief explanation of how each expense relates to remote work tasks.
Missing documentation may result in delays or denial of reimbursement.

Exclusions include non-essential office furniture (e.g., file cabinets, additional seating), items or services for personal use, and home office costs beyond the company's standard provision (e.g., renovations or office decor).
Certain expenses may be subject to limits based on prescribed budgets, which employees learn of upon pre-approval.
The finance department aims to reimburse employees within one billing cycle following approval of an expense report, via regular paycheck or direct deposit.
BlueSky Innovations directly provides equipment and services such as laptops, software licenses, and communication tools where possible; these remain company property.
BlueSky Innovations reserves the right to amend the policy and will communicate changes to remote-working staff in a timely fashion.
Employees with questions should contact their direct supervisor or the HR department.
